scope: Research-route, docs, console and complete DeepSeek prompt update. No new encoder, data collection, training or remote monitor deployment. Primary paper pages reread; existing code/data contracts reviewed locally.
execution_locks: Existing upstream locks unchanged; new references are not installed runtime dependencies.

references.entry: Bhat et al. *Deep Burst Super-Resolution*. CVPR 2021。[论文](https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/CVPR2021/html/Bhat_Deep_Burst_Super-Resolution_CVPR_2021_paper.html)；[固定作者代码](https://github.com/goutamgmb/deep-burst-sr/tree/16f158e0553b6702cc1693c43f733c2830973278)。现有内容与融合基线。

Luo et al. *BSRT: Improving Burst Super-Resolution with Swin Transformer and Flow-Guided Deformable Alignment*. CVPRW 2022。[论文](https://arxiv.org/abs/2204.08332)；[作者代码](https://github.com/Algolzw/BSRT)。强骨干替换候选；完整 RAW 合规适配待做。
Dudhane et al. *Burst Image Restoration and Enhancement*. CVPR 2022。[论文](https://arxiv.org/abs/2110.03680)；[BIPNet](https://github.com/akshaydudhane16/BIPNet)。隐式对齐与跨帧通信近邻。

Dudhane et al. *Burstormer: Burst Image Restoration and Enhancement Transformer*. CVPR 2023。[论文](https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/CVPR2023/html/Dudhane_Burstormer_Burst_Image_Restoration_and_Enhancement_Transformer_CVPR_2023_paper.html)；[作者代码](https://github.com/akshaydudhane16/Burstormer)。已查部分特征/对齐/融合源码，未运行新模型。
Mildenhall et al. *Burst Denoising with Kernel Prediction Networks*. CVPR 2018。[作者论文与代码页](https://bmild.github.io/kpn/)。来源利用和优化参考。
Wronski et al. *Handheld Multi-Frame Super-Resolution*. ACM TOG 2019。[作者机构页](https://research.google/pubs/handheld-multi-frame-super-resolution/)。RAW 采样与鲁棒融合依据。

Wang, Lipson and Deng. *SEA-RAFT: Simple, Efficient, Accurate RAFT for Optical Flow*. ECCV 2024。[论文](https://arxiv.org/html/2405.14793v1)；[作者代码](https://github.com/princeton-vl/SEA-RAFT)。已复用完整模块，P2 风险/泛化边界按验收保留。
*WAFT: Warping-Alone Field Transforms for Optical Flow*. 2025 预印本。[论文](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.21526)；[作者代码](https://github.com/princeton-vl/WAFT)。运动替换近邻，未做 RAW 运行验收。

*RViDeformer: Efficient Raw Video Denoising Transformer with a Larger Benchmark Dataset*. TCSVT 2025（早期预印本 2023）。[论文](https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.00767)；[作者代码/数据](https://github.com/cao-cong/RViDeformer)。ReCRVD 显示屏重拍范围须披露。
*AIM 2025 Low-light RAW Video Denoising Challenge: Dataset, Methods and Results*. 2025。[论文](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.16830)。多传感器 RAW 数据与评测参考，未取得/运行新数据。

Di et al. *QMambaBSR: Burst Image Super-Resolution with Query State Space Model*. CVPR 2025。[论文](https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/CVPR2025/html/Di_QMambaBSR_Burst_Image_Super-Resolution_with_Query_State_Space_Model_CVPR_2025_paper.html)。查询状态空间融合近邻。

Zhu et al. *Trajectory-aware Shifted State Space Models for Online Video Super-Resolution*. ICLR 2026。[论文](https://arxiv.org/html/2508.10453v2)；[TS-Mamba 作者代码](https://github.com/QZ1-boy/TS-Mamba)。已查方法与仓库，README 的训练配置路径访问失败，不能声称开箱可训练或 RAW 适配完成。

Shi et al. *MemoryVLA: Perceptual-Cognitive Memory in Vision-Language-Action Models for Robotic Manipulation*. ICLR 2026。[论文](https://arxiv.org/html/2508.19236v2)；[作者代码](https://github.com/shihao1895/MemoryVLA)。检索、融合与记忆合并近邻。
Shi et al. *MemoryVLA++: Temporal Modeling via Memory and Imagination in Vision-Language-Action Models*. 2026 预印本。[论文](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09827)。记忆/想象边界，不因相关而把世界模型加入 N01。
Jiang et al. *RoboTTT: Context Scaling for Robot Policies*. 2026 预印本。[论文](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.15275)；[作者机构页](https://research.nvidia.com/labs/gear/robottt/)。长上下文和序列训练参考，不声称 fast weights 可直接删源。
Adams and MacKay. *Bayesian Online Changepoint Detection*. 2007。[论文](https://arxiv.org/abs/0710.3742)。标准变化检测对照。

Altamirano, Briol and Knoblauch. *Robust and Scalable Bayesian Online Changepoint Detection*. ICML 2023。[论文](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v202/altamirano23a.html)；[DSM-bocd 作者代码](https://github.com/maltamiranomontero/DSM-bocd)。鲁棒参考，条件保证不混为频率学误报界。

Howard et al. *Time-uniform, Nonparametric, Nonasymptotic Confidence Sequences*. Annals of Statistics 2021。[论文](https://arxiv.org/abs/1810.08240)；[confseq](https://github.com/gostevehoward/confseq)。条件适用的顺序推断。

Shin, Ramdas and Rinaldo. *E-detectors: A Nonparametric Framework for Sequential Change Detection*。[论文](https://arxiv.org/abs/2203.03532)；[期刊原文](https://nejsds.nestat.org/journal/NEJSDS/article/59/text)。平均误报间隔与检测延迟参考，不能换成全程误报概率结论。
Sünderhauf and Protzel. *Switchable Constraints for Robust Pose Graph SLAM*. IROS 2012。[作者论文](https://nikosuenderhauf.github.io/assets/papers/IROS12-switchableConstraints.pdf)。错误约束退出的已有机制。

Kaess et al. *iSAM2: Incremental Smoothing and Mapping Using the Bayes Tree*. IJRR 2012。[作者页](https://people.csail.mit.edu/kaess/pub/Kaess12ijrr.html)；[GTSAM](https://github.com/borglab/gtsam)。依赖重求解参考，不强制搬成 GPU 主线。
Cui and Harada. *RAW-Adapter: Adapting Pre-trained Visual Model to Camera RAW Images*. ECCV 2024。[论文](https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.14802)。适配近邻，ISP 路线不是本主链。

Huang et al. *Dr. RAW: Towards General High-Level Vision from RAW with Efficient Task Conditioning*. NeurIPS 2025。[论文](https://proceedings.neurips.cc/paper_files/paper/2025/hash/20eadb6338a53114a6371f102c5ded95-Abstract-Conference.html)。传感器/任务适配近邻，预处理与重马赛克另审。
Li et al. *Towards RAW Object Detection in Diverse Conditions*. CVPR 2025。[论文](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.15678)；[AODRaw 作者代码/数据](https://github.com/lzyhha/AODRaw)。RAW 预训练与数据不足的依据；RGB 教师蒸馏不进入本主训练链。

Liu et al. *RawVLA: Embodied Neural Image Signal Processor for Robotic Manipulation*. 2026 预印本。[原文及训练协议](https://arxiv.org/html/2609.37530v1)；[作者项目](https://shuhongll.github.io/rawvla/)。直接竞争边界，实际输入以固定数据审计为准。

Physical Intelligence et al. *π0.5: a Vision-Language-Action Model with Open-World Generalization*. 2025。[论文](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.16054)；[openpi](https://github.com/Physical-Intelligence/openpi)。执行仍用冻结 StarVLA/RawVLA 接口与权重。
Lehtinen et al. *Noise2Noise: Learning Image Restoration without Clean Data*. ICML 2018。[论文](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v80/lehtinen18a.html)。辅助监督的条件依据。
Batson and Royer. *Noise2Self: Blind Denoising by Self-Supervision*. ICML 2019。[论文](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v97/batson19a.html)。噪声独立与 J-invariance 的适用边界。
Jain and Wallace. *Attention is not Explanation*. NAACL 2019。[论文](https://aclanthology.org/N19-1357/)。原实验在 NLP，不直接当作视觉注意力无效定理。
Wiegreffe and Pinter. *Attention is not not Explanation*. EMNLP 2019。[论文](https://aclanthology.org/D19-1002.pdf)。解释性需要具体干预/对照实验。

Jaegle et al. *Perceiver IO: A General Architecture for Structured Inputs & Outputs*. ICLR 2022。[论文](https://arxiv.org/abs/2107.14795)；[官方实现](https://github.com/google-deepmind/deepmind-research/tree/master/perceiver)。按需读出候选。
Gu and Dao. *Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces*. COLM 2024。[论文](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.00752)；[官方实现](https://github.com/state-spaces/mamba)。状态候选，整体稳定/删除保证需另证。

Revay, Wang and Manchester. *Recurrent Equilibrium Networks: Flexible Dynamic Models with Guaranteed Stability and Robustness*. IEEE TAC 2023。[论文](https://arxiv.org/abs/2104.05942)；[作者代码](https://github.com/imanchester/REN)。稳定结构参考，不将其保证转移给任意 Mamba 组合。
Brooks et al. *Unprocessing Images for Learned Raw Denoising*. CVPR2019。[论文](https://arxiv.org/abs/1811.11127)；[作者代码](https://github.com/timothybrooks/unprocessing)。成像与噪声域参考，逆处理不恢复源RGB已丢失信息。
Chen et al. *Learning to See in the Dark*. CVPR2018。[论文](https://arxiv.org/abs/1805.01934)；[作者代码](https://github.com/cchen156/Learning-to-See-in-the-Dark)。短曝光RAW研究背景，RGB恢复目标不进入主链。
Cui and Harada. *RAW-Adapter*. ECCV2024。[论文](https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.14802)；[作者代码](https://github.com/cuiziteng/ECCV_RAW_Adapter)。已有RAW高层视觉适配。
Huang et al. *Dr. RAW*. NeurIPS2025。[论文](https://papers.neurips.cc/paper_files/paper/2025/hash/20eadb6338a53114a6371f102c5ded95-Abstract-Conference.html)。已有传感器条件与任务适配，不借其结果保证N01。
